cards.headline: A street in Nanjing, read like a letter
cards.snippet: A sung-spoken inventory of one Nanjing street. 热河 ('Rehe') is track six on 1701, Li Zhi's seventh studio album, released by Xiami Music on 13 November 2014 and written entirely by Li Zhi. Its subject is Rehe Road in the old Xiaguan district: plane trees, dust and grocery stalls, a crayfish restaurant, a cinema, the old West Station, the number 32 bus. Nearly everything it names was already vanishing — Xiaguan District itself had been merged into Gulou the year before the album appeared. Over a slow, circling arrangement he reads the landmarks off like addresses on letters he can no longer send, until the refrain lands: no one falls in love on Rehe Road; there is always someone sentimental at dawn.
cards.context: Li Zhi was born in Jintan County — the place the song's opening lines name — and has lived in Nanjing since arriving there for university in 1997.

cards.headline: The vanishing, and the long way back
cards.snippet: Li Zhi's New Year's Eve concerts were a Nanjing institution, and 'Rehe' became their emotional centrepiece; the 2016–17 edition, rearranged with jazz musicians, is the performance most listeners know. In February 2019 his Sichuan tour was cancelled at two days' notice; that April his accounts closed and his catalogue disappeared from mainland platforms, where it remains unavailable. The songs survived in fan archives and on YouTube, where fans kept re-uploading performances. His band played on as San Que Yi — 'Three Missing One' — and the 2019 Midi Awards introduced him only as 'Mr Li, a citizen of Nanjing'. In November 2025 he sang 'Rehe' in Kuala Lumpur, to an audience flown in from three continents.
cards.context: Critic Ma Shih-fang's much-quoted verdict on these songs: they fuse the small self with the large, and speak for a generation of young people who left home to work.

cards.headline: Thirty hours from America, for all three nights
cards.snippet: 三场都去了，从美国折腾了30h到吉隆坡
cards.context: The most-liked comment under a fan's film of the Kuala Lumpur show of 13 November 2025. He caught all three Malaysia nights; the replies swap flight times — 17 hours from London, a cancelled Paris flight.

replies.author: @吴涵-p6t
replies.text: 太强了， 我从uk过去17小时我都累的想死

cards.headline: The best 'Rehe' there is
cards.context: The most-liked listener verdict on Taihe Music's film of the 2017 New Year's concert. The replies argue for other years — the 2015 tour version's bass solo, the 2016 unplugged take.

source.name: YouTube — 太合音樂 Taihe Music-精選

replies.author: @englishtp65p4
replies.text: 我最喜歡的是2015看見版熱河，Bass solo 太加分了

cards.headline: Ten years on, they will still be listening at night
cards.snippet: 此曲十年之后，又会发生什么呢？B哥还是会看到与他预期不符但又势不可挡的时代洪流，人民群众还是会在夜深人静时重新聆听热河。
cards.context: Under the same 2017 concert film, whose title was 'Believe in the Future' （相信未来）. He wonders what another ten years will do to the song — and to the people still listening to it in the small hours.

source.name: YouTube — 太合音樂 Taihe Music-精選

replies.author: @VincentVanVan04110
replies.text: 明年就十年了，这样一想有点恐怖，时间过得太快了。

replies.author: @wangxiao-z9o
replies.text: 发生不了什么，单个人物在历史的长河中如萤火虫一样，清朝都坚持了小 300 年，5/4 运动到现在，中国大陆依旧没有进入到比较好的现代文明体系当中，未来还需要多少年的路要走不得而知。

cards.headline: Abroad, and it makes him cry
cards.snippet: 我特么在国外，听着听着想哭
cards.context: One line from the diaspora, under the 2017 concert film. Both replies agree with it — one from abroad, one from home.

source.name: YouTube — 太合音樂 Taihe Music-精選

cards.headline: Nanjing, 2017: the 'Believe in the Future' New Year's concert
cards.snippet: Li Zhi's New Year's concerts were a Nanjing ritual. This is 'Rehe' from the 2016–17 'Believe in the Future' edition, rearranged with jazz musicians — the reading released on his 2018 album of jazz and unplugged remakes. One listener: "这版的编曲真是太棒了"
cards.context: The Taihe upload is the song's most-watched performance film, and the thread beneath it argues over which year did the song best — this one, the 2015 tour, or the 2016 unplugged night.

source.name: YouTube — 太合音樂 Taihe Music-精選

version.versionLabel: 熱河（2017跨年版）— 'Believe in the Future' New Year's concert, Nanjing

cards.headline: Kuala Lumpur, 2025: the return reaches Malaysia
cards.snippet: On 13 November 2025, seven years after his mainland disappearance, Li Zhi sang 'Rehe' in Kuala Lumpur on the San Que Yi ('Three Missing One') tour. A fan's film of the night is among the song's most-watched performances. One listener: "感谢上传 🎉 这个版本真好，目前为止最好的现场版。"
cards.context: The thread beneath the film is a roll-call of the far-flung — fans who flew in from America, Britain and France for three nights in Kuala Lumpur.

version.versionLabel: Live in Kuala Lumpur — San Que Yi （叁缺壹） tour
